title: Nothing typed in the simulator is saved
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, one range from $0.00 with Default on Markup % 50.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Type 250 in the Price Part Simulator's Part Cost.
  4. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  5. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens on the Work Order Matrix tab.

Step 3:

  • Default's simulator price reads $375.00 ($250.00 × 1.50 = $375.00).

Step 4:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 5:

  • The Part Cost reads $100.00 again.
  • Default's simulator price reads $150.00 and the grid still shows 50% markup.
